Summary Files Reviews Support Code Svn Tickets ▾ Bugs Feature Requests News Discussion Donate Menu ▾ ▴ Create Ticket View Stats Group v1.0_(example) Searches Changes Closed Tickets Open Tickets Help Formatting Help #112 Incorrect mapping of the MET time zone Status: closed Owner: Stephen Colebourne Labels: Joda-Time (76) Priority: 5 Updated: 2012-10-08 Created: 2011-03-16 Creator: Raymond Barlow Private: No This timezone is mapped to Asia/Tehran in DateTimeZone. It should be middle europena time. I know that this bug has been raised before (Incorrect mapping of the MET time zone - ID: 2012274), and there is a comment stating that you won't break backward compatibility to fix this bug. I disagree that this is a backward compatibility argument No matter how you look at it, it is a bug. You could very well state that ALL bugs won't be fixed, because of backward compatibility. I request again that this bug be fixed. Discussion Stephen Colebourne - 2011-03-31 Change made as part of the small incompatibiliies of v2.0.
